ValidationRule.description: Block user from manually updating the status to closed from record for TrustMe Cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), AND( AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Rectify Defect')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Refer to Fraud')) ), OR(ISNULL( Verified_By__c ), ISBLANK(Verified_By__c) )), ISCHANGED( Status ) , OR( RecordType.DeveloperName == 'TrustMe_eIDV_QA_Case', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'TrustMe_eIDV_Case', RecordType.DeveloperName == 'ReKYC_QA_Case' ), NOT(IsClosed) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update the case using the Update Status action.
